cover.description:
https://boneio.eu/docs/black/configuration/cover 
 Cover section of boneIO Black. It enables cover entities in HA. You'd need output config to use it first.

open_relay.description: ID of open relay of output.
open_relay.title: Open relay

close_relay.description: ID of close relay of output.
close_relay.title: Close relay

open_time.description: Time to open cover. Example 30s. Minimum is 1s.
open_time.title: Open time

close_time.description: Time to close cover. Example 30s. Minimum is 1s.
close_time.title: Close time

tilt_duration.description: Time to tilt cover. Example 2s. Minimum is 10ms.
tilt_duration.title: Tilt duration

actuator_activation_duration.description: Time from switching the relay on until the motor starts moving, added to every movement. Example 200ms for Somfy J4 WT, which ignores shorter orders. Default 0ms.
actuator_activation_duration.title: Actuator activation duration

endstop_overrun.description: Extra relay time when the cover moves to fully open or fully closed, as a percent of open_time/close_time. The cover runs into its endstop, so the time-based position is exact again at 0% and 100%. 0 disables it.
endstop_overrun.title: Endstop overrun

direction_change_wait_time.description: Pause before the cover is driven in the opposite direction, so the motor stops before it reverses. 0ms disables it.
direction_change_wait_time.title: Direction change wait time

tilt_restore_after_close.description: Restore tilt position after closing venetian blinds.
tilt_restore_after_close.title: Tilt restore after close

device_class.description: Device class to use in HA
device_class.title: Device class

show_in_ha.description: If you want you can disable discovering this input in HA.
show_in_ha.title: Show in ha

facade_azimuth.description: Which way the window faces, in degrees clockwise from north (90 east, 180 south, 270 west). With it and the location set, the controller knows when the sun shines on the window: a "sun on" binary sensor in Home Assistant, and schedules that run when the sun reaches or leaves the window.
facade_azimuth.title: Facade azimuth

facade_min_elevation.description: The sun counts as on the window only above this many degrees over the horizon - raise it when a neighbouring house or trees shade the window while the sun is low.
facade_min_elevation.title: Facade min elevation

cover.title: Cover
